sloka: तथैव रणरक्तस्तु मुष्टिना वासवानुजम् ।ताडयित्वा धनुर्मात्रमपक्रान्तो निशाचरः ।। ७.८.१६ ॥
transliteration: tathaiva raṇaraktastu muṣṭinā vāsavānujam ।tāḍayitvā dhanurmātramapakrānto niśācaraḥ ।। 7.8.16 ॥

translations.english: The demon, eager for battle, struck Vishnu (Upendra) with his fist and then retreated a bow's length.
